HOTELWORTH ROMEOSON LIMALEY

Incident page for this loss

Name: WO1 Romeoson Limaley Hotelworth
Reason: aircraft lost or crashed
Unit: 190 AHC, 12 CAG
Status: Killed In Action from a loss on 03/22/1970; duty: Pilot.
Service: U.S. Army; reserve component; AV branch
Country: South Vietnam

Short Summary: Single-ship hover-down LZ on a rocky ledge in jungle; an RPG hit the left rear of the cabin and blew the tailboom off.
